name: Aldric Thorne
descr: Aldric Thorne was born to a noble house and trained as an officer in a foreign army, until he walked away from a war he could no longer believe in. He meets every conflict with good manners first and a longsword second.

features.name: High Stamina
features.text: Gain an additional Stress slot at character creation.

features.name: Adaptability
features.text: When you fail a roll that utilized one of your Experiences, you can **mark a Stress** to reroll.

features.name: Privilege
features.text: You have advantage on rolls to consort with nobles, negotiate prices, or leverage your reputation to get what you want.

hopeFeature.name: No Mercy
hopeFeature.text: **Spend 3 Hope** to gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls until your next rest.

features.name: Attack of Opportunity
features.text:
If an adversary within Melee range attempts to leave that range, make a reaction roll using a trait of your choice against their Difficulty. Choose one effect on a success, or two if you critically succeed:

- They can't move from where they are.
- You deal damage to them equal to your primary weapon's damage.
- You move with them.

features.name: Combat Training
features.text: You ignore burden when equipping weapons. When you deal physical damage, you gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to your level.

foundations.name: Courage
foundations.text: When you fail a roll with Fear, you gain a Hope.

foundations.name: Battle Ritual
foundations.text: Once per long rest, before you attempt something incredibly dangerous or face off against a foe who clearly outmatches you, describe what ritual you perform or preparations you make. When you do, clear 2 Stress and gain 2 Hope.

specializations.name: Rise to the Challenge
specializations.text: You are vigilant in the face of mounting danger. While you have 2 or fewer Hit Points unmarked, you can roll a **d20** as your Hope Die.

masteries.name: Camaraderie
masteries.text: Your unwavering bravery is a rallying point for your allies. You can initiate a Tag Team Roll one additional time per session. Additionally, when an ally initiates a Tag Team Roll with you, they only need to spend 2 Hope to do so.

inventory.name: Sharpening Stone
inventory.descr: A worn whetstone that has kept his blade keen through many campaigns.

domainCards.name: Not Good Enough
domainCards.descr: When you roll your damage dice, you can reroll any 1s or 2s.

domainCards.name: I See It Coming
domainCards.descr: When you're targeted by an attack made from beyond Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to roll a **d4** and gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to the result against the attack.

appearance.clothes: A fine but travel-worn noble's coat over his armor
appearance.attitude: Courteous, generous and slow to anger

data.background: Aldric left his commission when he was ordered to burn a village that had already surrendered. His family name still opens doors, but he would rather be known for his deeds than his lineage. He believes that kindness is a weapon most people forget to carry.
data.connections:
- We knew each other long before this party came together. How?

- What mundane task do you usually help me with off the battlefield?

- What fear am I helping you overcome?
